sources.text: 7 products in 14 days as of Sep 29, 2026 (5 open source, 2 private) across trading, AI research, event prediction, math, reasoning, month-end close, and software engineering. Infra metrics are internal tests with different baselines; they can’t be multiplied or added. Post-round steps are plans.
Mercor revenue concentration: The Information (Jul 2026): about $614M gross revenue in H1 2026, over 90% from three foundation-model companies. Competitor names are industry examples.
Use of funds, headcount, and next steps are plans. Benchmarks: Mercor (Forbes, Dealroom, Jun 2026); AfterQuery (Business Wire, Apr 2026); Meta, OpenAI launches (Sep 2026).
